title: Mars’ Hidden 200‑km‑Wide Subsurface Lake Found by Radar

scenes.text: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter radar detected a 200‑km‑wide lake beneath the Tharsis region.
Lake depth is estimated at 1 km, covering a volume of about 100 billion cubic meters.
This underground reservoir could be a relic of ancient Mars, holding clues to past habitability.
